signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to AnyPlay with a passkey or a code by e-mail.

create.title: Create your account
create.description: Create your AnyPlay account: an e-mail address and a handle.

link.title: Open your account
link.description: Open your AnyPlay account in this browser, from the launcher.

join.title: Invitation
join.description: An invitation to play together on AnyPlay.

flow.authorize: AnyPlay on {device} is waiting for this sign-in.

create.title: Create your account
create.lead: Start with your e-mail address. We send a code to confirm it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: Use your passkey, or get a code by e-mail.

email.label: E-mail address
email.invalid: Enter your e-mail address, like name@example.com.

code.title: Check your e-mail
code.lead: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
code.incomplete: Enter the 6 digits from the e-mail.
code.resent: A new code is on its way.
code.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s

details.title: Choose a handle
details.lead: Your address {email} is confirmed. Other players see your handle.
details.handleHint: Use 3 to 16 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Start with a letter.
details.age: I am old enough to agree to the terms on my own.
details.terms: I accept the <terms>terms</terms> (version {version}) and have read the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.

terms.title: Review the terms
terms.lead: The terms changed. Read the <terms>terms</terms> and accept version {version} to continue.

banned.title: This account is banned
banned.leadForever: The ban does not end on its own.

handoff.title: Signed in
handoff.lead: Taking you back to AnyPlay. If nothing happens, use the button.
handoff.note: You can close this tab once AnyPlay shows you as signed in.

done.title: You’re signed in
done.inviteLead: Taking you back to the invitation.
done.welcome: Welcome, {handle}. Your friends, parties and trophies are waiting in the launcher.

join.expiredLead: The link may have run out, or the player has stopped playing. Ask them for a new one.
join.title: {handle} invited you
join.leadSignedIn: Open AnyPlay on your PC to see the invitation. You choose there whether to join.
join.leadSignedOut: Sign in or create an account first. You come back here to open the invitation.
join.players: {members} of {max, plural, one {# player} other {# players}}
join.noApp: No AnyPlay on this PC yet? Get it first, then open this page again.

link.expiredLead: Open your account page from AnyPlay again.
link.title: Open your account
link.lead: AnyPlay on your PC asked to open the account of {handle} in this browser.
link.notYou: Did not ask for this? Close the tab.
